Items.Description: The customer's biography is passed to bypassSecurityTrustHtml and bound to innerHTML: a script in the biography runs in other customers' browsers.
Items.FixRecommendation: Do not pass user-controlled data to bypassSecurityTrustHtml. Bind the value to innerHTML and let Angular sanitize it.

Items.Description: acme-date-picker 3.1.0 merges user options into a shared object without filtering __proto__ (prototype pollution).
